evals.prompt: We're building a marketplace where sellers get paid out after each sale. Recommend the Stripe Connect charge pattern and account type.
evals.expected_output: Uses Connect recommend references instead of inventing Connect advice
expectations: Reads charge-patterns or account-types or decision-matrix before recommending
Does not skip the skill because the user said marketplace
Does not invent a Connect charge type that is not in the references

evals.prompt: We need split payments and a white-label Dashboard for vendors. Which Connect setup should we use?
evals.expected_output: Routes through Connect recommend terminology and compatibility guidance
expectations: Asks discovery questions when the business model is still vague
Does not default to a simple PaymentIntent for a multi-party payout
